description: Append-only registry of safety test IDs (floor 10). Add new entries at the end; never remove or rename an entry. Checked by floor10-append-only.test.js.

tests.title: mutation report: baseline passes, 0 survivors, 0 compile errors/timeouts/errors
mutation report is not stale: every mutated site still reads as recorded
mutation report is complete: every constraint statement in every target is a site
every project circuit file in the v4 main's include closure is covered
arrow audit (circuits/scripts/mutate.js --audit-arrows) reports 0 violations
independent arrow audit: each <-- / --> is followed by an === on the same signal
the 7 redundant-but-killed v4 sites are killed by their component's own spec
v3: the 2 equivalent mutants (redundant booleans in P1's main) keep their equivalence tests
control: the TEST-ONLY issuer key reproduces the fixtures' pinned key and an honest input has a witness
tampered attribute (each of the 6, signature and path kept) -> no witness
tampered attribute that WOULD satisfy the stricter policy (engineer claims admin, clearance 3) -> no witness
forged signature under the PINNED key (attrHash signed by another key, pinned key claimed) -> no witness
self-signed credential under the FORGER's key: witness exists (by design) but the proof carries the forger key; with the pinned key substituted it does not verify
off-curve issuer key or R8 -> no witness
unsatisfied policy with honest, issuer-signed attributes -> no witness (each policy clause)
a valid proof for one policy does not verify with another resource's policy signals
expired credential (expiry == now, expiry < now) -> no witness; expiry = now + 1 -> witness
range wrap-arounds on expiry/now (expiry = now + 2^64, now = p - 1) -> no witness
out-of-range attribute even when the issuer signed it (role 4, clearance 5, device 2) -> no witness
the real issuer refuses expired and out-of-range attributes (issuer.api v1)
v3 proofs are not admissible under the v4 key (v3 binds no issuer/policy/time)
every one of the 12 public signals tampered on a valid fixture -> verify false
only an authenticated enrolment path can obtain issuer-signed attributes

tests.title: control: before revocation Bob's input had a witness against the then-current root
revoked: GET /path is 410 and the client refuses to prepare a proof
Bob's old path against the CURRENT root -> no witness
Bob's leaf with the CURRENT tree's siblings at his index -> no witness (his slot is 0 now)
the zero leaf is a tree member, but v4 has no leaf/M input: the leaf is the in-circuit attrHash
unrevoked Alice still proves against the current root (revocation is targeted)
staleness rule: a root superseded by a revocation is never acceptable, even inside 30 s
fixtures: stale_root_bob_wiki carries the pre-revocation root, which the vectors' tree loses on delete(1)
a revoked holder cannot obtain a replacement credential without the admin

gateway denies a used nonce and an expired nonce (TTL 120 s)

tests.title: nullifier = Poseidon(3)(credentialSecret, resourceId, epoch): lib == fixture == witness
same user, same resource, same epoch, different nonces -> equal nullifiers (rate-limitable)
nullifier independent of nonce and of now within the epoch (witness level)
unlinkable across services: same user, different resourceId -> different nullifiers
nothing in the public signals links one user's proofs across services except shared policy/root/issuer
different epochs -> different nullifiers (sessions do not link across epochs)
gateway rate-limits (nullifier, epoch) to one admission per epoch
